title: Ratings capture
inspection: six evenly spaced frames visually reviewed
viewport: mobile portrait; encoded pixel dimensions are not device-point dimensions
observations: Pixel-styled headings, outlined buttons, and cannabis-leaf graphics sit on saturated gradients. A rating prompt and feedback confirmation overlay a notification preview, followed by a subscription carousel with changing artwork and a persistent purchase area.
learning_candidate: Strong visual consistency is evident, while stacking rating, notification, and purchase requests creates a separate friction question.
